Build is clean (exit 0). The screen full of warnings was mostly noise (deprecation notices from the bump), but two real bugs were hiding in the link stage:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

Build now finishes with the original 8 (harmless) deprecation warnings and 0 errors.
